continuity_scope: SEGA/Atlus English Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance, Canon of Creation route only, released 14 June 2024. The official site says Canon of Creation follows the original Shin Megami Tensei V story, whereas Canon of Vengeance is a distinct route that diverges midway with a different ending. Vengeance-only Yoko/Qadištu/DLC, the 2021 base release as an independently shipped version, and all other SMT/spinoff titles are excluded.
work_or_witnesses: SEGA Asia, Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Official Story & Characters, Canon of Creation
SEGA Asia, SMT V: Vengeance Official System page
coverage_rule: All named, directly profiled individual human/angel dramatic figures in the Canon of Creation selected page: the title-designated Protagonist, Aogami, Tao Isonokami, Yuzuru Atsuta, Ichiro Dazai, and Abdiel. The profile makes the protagonist a stable title-designated record despite player naming. Individually profiled demon/deity figures and the Vengeance route are excluded under the declared human/angel Canon-of-Creation scope; generic collectible demons and mythic/deity categories remain terms.
omissions: Canon of Vengeance/Yoko/Qadištu content, Vengeance DLC demons/quests, base-SMT-V DLC as a separately shipped content state, and all later route/ending outcomes.

All player names, alignment/route decisions, demon negotiation/fusion/party selection, unprofiled characters, demons/deities as collectible kinds, and individual mythological figures outside the stated human/angel card set.
All other Shin Megami Tensei, Persona, Devil Summoner, mobile/crossover/spinoff works, localizations/patches, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: Canon of Creation is presented through Vengeance’s 2024 product page and said to follow the original story; this is not treated as textual identity for every 2021 release/localization/patch state.
The protagonist is nameable/player-controlled, so route, alignment, demon party, skills, and endings remain player-variable attributes rather than fixed facts.

Religious, folkloric, and mythological names on the wider official demon roster are adaptation/collection materials; they are not generalized into real-world theological claims or added as nodes here.
evidence_basis: Official SEGA/Atlus English Vengeance Canon-of-Creation and system pages only. No fan source is used as canonical evidence.
